evidence.reason: The nonzero-exit path raises `BuildError` after `communicate()` returns without calling `_kill_process_group`; only `TimeoutExpired` and other exceptions clean up the process group. A descendant with redirected stdio can therefore survive a failed command and keep writing in the guarded checkout after `run_command` raises, creating the retry/race the finding describes. This is an implementation bug in the existing process-group cleanup, not a new requirement; verify or terminate the group before returning or raising.
